hooks: Wondering what dinner you can make with whatever is in your fridge?
Tired of letting leftover groceries go to waste every single week?
Staring at a half-empty fridge with no idea what to cook?
hook_card_prompt: A bright, clean kitchen counter with colorful fresh vegetables, soft natural morning sunlight, and an earthy warm aesthetic.

problem.voice_line: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

claims.text: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.

demos.voice_line: Snap a photo of your open fridge to detect ingredients from one photo. The camera display shows the camera button and the open fridge.

claims.text: Snap a photo of your open fridge to detect ingredients from one photo.
The camera display shows the camera button and the open fridge.

demos.voice_line: Choose from three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use. Three recipe cards appear on screen. The recipe cards show matched ingredients highlighted.

claims.text: Choose from three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use.
Three recipe cards appear on screen.
The recipe cards show matched ingredients highlighted.

how.voice_line: Under the hood, vision code detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge. The backend ranks three recipes by your matched ingredients.

claims.text: Vision code detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge.
The backend ranks three recipes by your matched ingredients.

impact.voice_line: Busy home cooks stop wasting food and time by cooking with ingredients already at home.

claims.text: Busy home cooks stop wasting food and time by cooking with ingredients already at home.

ask.voice_line: Try PantryPal today and vote for us in the hackathon!
